body.p: Anna Galan and Bonnie Mehring will organice a FSFE meet-up, where they will talk about volunteering. So, if you are an FSFE volunteer, or are interested in becoming one and to help us to promote software freedom, then this is the perfect session for you! You will learn more about FSFE volunteer engagement and how best to participate in our international movement for Free Software.
The workshop will be in English and it will take place in the Crane Hall – Workshop A.
